name: CopyButton
description: Copies text to the clipboard while the copy icon spins into a self-drawing check mark and the label rolls to "Copied", then resets after a configurable delay. Optionally shows the copied value in an inline code field.
a11yNotes: Native <button>; when the value field is shown or the button is icon-only it gets an explicit aria-label ("Copy command" / "Copied"). A polite role="status" live region announces "Copied to clipboard". Icons are aria-hidden. Falls back to a hidden textarea + execCommand when the async Clipboard API is unavailable. Under prefers-reduced-motion the icon and label cross-fade without rotation, blur or path drawing.

propsApi.name: resetDelay
propsApi.description: Milliseconds before the button returns to idle (minimum 300).

propsApi.name: showValue
propsApi.description: Render the text in a monospace field beside the button.

propsApi.name: iconOnly
propsApi.description: Hide the label and show only the morphing icon.

propsApi.name: accentColor
propsApi.description: Color of the check mark and copied state.

propsApi.name: onCopy
propsApi.description: Called after the text was copied successfully.

propsApi.name: className
propsApi.description: Additional class merged onto the root element.

propsApi.name: style
propsApi.description: Inline styles merged onto the root element.
